profile.headline: Software Developer at Applus Technologies
profile.summary: Software Engineer with 5 years of experience in the .NET stack. I enjoy the architectural aspect of software development as well as the deep understanding of "syntactical sugar" that any language offers. I encourage and welcome the perspectives of others when it comes to providing a solution. I welcome the advise and constructive criticism of others so that I may improve upon my weaknesses and learn the best approach to any software development task. Experience within the Logistics and Automotive industry.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.locationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States

company.name: MyFlightSolutions, a Flying Software Labs Co.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
DealerSocket provides a variety of software applications to the automotive industry. 
My role within the company was to work in a team environment to acomplish the ongoing projects.

Responsibilities:
• Building and updating various pages of the CRM product to allow for a better user experience.
• Developed and maintained the email and campaign features of the CRM product.
• Improved customer satisfaction by refactoring and fixing defects.

Technologies Used:
• Javascript
• Visual Basic
• C# .NET 4.5
• SQL Server 2012
• Angular
• Bootstrap

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Falcon Fulfillment is a 3rd Party Logistics company. My main role within the company is to connect our merchant's E-Commerce systems with our Warehouse System using Web Services. I meet with the company's merchants to determine the most efficient way to automate their Fulfillment needs. On a day-to-day basis, I create data reports using stored procedures that can be accessed by Falcon's employees and merchants through the Warehouse System.

Responsibilities:
• Developed and maintained all client software integrations.
• Developed and maintained our Fulfillment and Shipment Software.
• Maintained database and created data reports for internal and client purposes.
• Helped maintain dev and production servers.
• Performed QA on all features before deployment to production.
• Coordinated the migration of the company’s technology assets to a new location.

Technologies Used:
• C# .NET 4.5
• SQL Server 2012
• Web Services
• JSON
• XML

positions.title: Software Developer Internship
positions.description:
This was an internship that was provided through the company and Neumont University. The collaboration enabled me to receive real-world experience in software development.

Responsibilities:
• Fixed and created automated unit tests that provide maintenance for the company’s website and software suite.

Technologies Used:
• C# .NET 4.5
• Coded UI Tests
• Team Foundation Server
• SQL Server 2008

positions.title: Software Developer Internship
positions.description:
This was an internship that was provided through the company and Neumont University. The collaboration enabled me to receive real-world experience in software development.

Responsibilities:
• Localized the software that uGenius provides to its clients. This enabled the software to be translated at a faster pace.
• Manually tested uGenius’ various builds through case documents.
• Modified various application layers to satisfy localization needs.

Technologies Used:
• C#
• ASP.NET
• SQL Server 2008
